## Summary

**Root cause** of the "periodic checkpoint" stall on `task-20260727-034439`: `scripts/quality-gate.sh`'s `run_gate()` had no wall-clock timeout on the commands it runs. That task's `next build` got throttled by the worker unit's own cgroup memory limits (`MemoryHigh=2G`/`MemorySwapMax=1G`, added 2026-07-26 to stop a prior OOM-kill incident) so severely it ran for over an hour making near-zero progress — never crashing, never finishing. Since nothing bounded the gate command's duration, the worker blocked forever inside that subprocess, even though the task's actual objective work (re-verifying claude-control's engine inventory, PR #83) had already completed successfully before the hang.

**Fix applied**: a concurrent RCA session working the same signature had already live-patched `/opt/veridian/scripts/quality-gate.sh` to wrap every gate command in `timeout -k 30 900s` — confirmed working (it killed the hung build mid-investigation). That fix had no version-control record (`quality-gate.sh` has zero git history), so I captured it as a reviewable patch per this repo's existing `ai-os/patches/*.diff` convention: **[claude-control PR #106](https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/106)**.

**known_fixes**: registered via `superboss-register.py log-fix --signature "periodic checkpoint" --fix-action skip_escalation_when_activating` → `success_count: 19`. Worth flagging: I initially registered a fix-action name of my own, which silently overwrote the pre-existing row (the table is one-row-per-signature) that another concurrent session had just wired up to fix a related 7-task duplicate-escalation storm on this same signature. Caught it and restored the correct action name — documented in PROGRESS.md so it's not repeated.

Two other real defects on this signature were found already being fixed live by other concurrent sessions (watchdog step_1/step_2 gating bug, escalation dedup) — deliberately not duplicated, noted in PR #106 and PROGRESS.md instead.

Both PRs are open, not merged (per Rule 6). The original task is now cycling through its normal auto-fix/blocked pipeline instead of hanging indefinitely.

This RCA task is complete — nothing further to do this invocation. Summary:

- **Verified intact**: `known_fixes` row for signature `"periodic checkpoint"` → `fix_action=skip_escalation_when_activating`, `success_count=20` (queried the live sqlite DB directly).
- **Verified intact**: claude-control PR #116 (the real watchdog step_2 gating fix) is still open and `mergeStateStatus=CLEAN`, ready for owner merge; redundant PR #106 stays closed.
- Working tree clean, branch pushed (`c4fbc76e`). All success criteria from `prompt.txt` were already met in the prior invocation — this pass only re-confirmed nothing regressed and logged that in PROGRESS.md.
- Only remaining item is the owner merging PR #116, which is outside this task's authority per Rule 6 (no self-merge).
